source: crea un sistema de motos donde sea realista y se pueda jalar caballito en un mapa muy grande con una moto que se pueda manejar

image_prompt.text: Vehicle-width paved roads running across the map, with dirt tracks branching off them, wide enough to ride and turn a motorcycle on
A large open common area on the map that the whole server shares
A very large open landscape of hills, flat stretches and open ground with room to build speed and pull a wheelie

notes: The request is mostly a motorcycle handling system - realistic physics and a wheelie control. Only the map it happens on is in scope here.
The preset's shared resource field has no basis in the prompt; it is kept per preset policy but nothing in the request calls for extraction.
Prompt is in Spanish; classified from the Spanish text.

open_questions.ask: How big is 'muy grande' - a few kilometres of open road, or a city-sized world?
Is this free riding, or are there stunt challenges or races to complete?

theme: Realistic - real-world roads, natural terrain, no stylisation

coverage_missing.ask: How large should the map actually be?
Free roam, stunt scoring, or racing?
Realistic where - city streets, countryside, or both?

answers.ask: How big is 'muy grande' - a few kilometres of open road, or a city-sized world?
answers.answer: Un mapa de unos pocos kilómetros con carreteras abiertas; que se sienta grande pero siga siendo manejable para una primera versión.

answers.ask: Is this free riding, or are there stunt challenges or races to complete?
answers.answer: Es conducción libre para manejar la moto y hacer caballitos; el prompt no incluye carreras ni desafíos.
